_comment: Big recurring Philly events. Dates come from recurrence rules so the list never goes stale; organizers occasionally shift dates, so each card links to the official site. weekday: Mon=0 ... Sun=6.

events.title: Mummers Parade
events.location: Broad Street, South Philly to City Hall
events.description: Feathers, sequins, string bands and Golden Sluggers. Philly's New Year's Day tradition since 1901.
events.closure: Broad Street and the blocks around City Hall close to traffic for most of the day. Take the Broad Street Line.

events.title: Broad Street Run
events.location: Broad St from Olney to the Navy Yard
events.description: Ten miles straight down Broad Street with tens of thousands of runners.
events.closure: Broad Street closes along the entire course from early morning until about noon.

events.title: Odunde Festival
events.description: One of the country's largest African American street festivals, with a procession to the Schuylkill.
events.closure: South Street and nearby blocks around 23rd close to traffic all day.

events.title: Wawa Welcome America
events.location: Citywide, finale on the Ben Franklin Parkway
events.description: Two weeks of free events that end with the July 4th parade, concert and fireworks.
events.closure: The Ben Franklin Parkway closes in the days before July 4th for the concert setup.

events.title: Head of the Schuylkill Regatta
events.description: Thousands of rowers race head-style down the Schuylkill (that's SKOO-kul).
events.closure: Expect lane restrictions and no parking along Kelly Drive near Boathouse Row.
events.date_note: Usually the fourth weekend of October; confirm on the regatta site.

events.title: Philadelphia Half Marathon & 8K
events.location: Starts on the Ben Franklin Parkway
events.closure: Rolling closures on the Parkway, through Center City and along Kelly and MLK Drives.

events.title: Philadelphia Marathon
events.location: Starts on the Ben Franklin Parkway
events.description: 26.2 miles from the Art Museum out to Manayunk and back.
events.closure: Rolling closures on the Parkway, in Center City, on Kelly and MLK Drives, and on Main Street in Manayunk.

events.title: Thanksgiving Day Parade
events.description: The country's oldest Thanksgiving Day parade, running since 1920.
events.closure: JFK Blvd and the Ben Franklin Parkway close from early morning into the afternoon.

events.title: Christmas Village in Philadelphia
events.description: German-style holiday market with glühwein, ornaments and a lot of pretzels.
events.date_note: Opening day varies; confirm on the market's site.

events.title: First Friday in Old City
events.description: Galleries and shops stay open late for the monthly art crawl.
